patch_classes.label: Request Contract Drift
patch_actions: compare runtime and replay method, URL, query, body, and header fields before changing signer code
parameterize only the divergent request field
rerun parity comparison after one request-contract patch
patch_classes.verification: runtime/replay request contract comparison shows method, URL, and fields match

patch_classes.label: Response Shape or Prerequisite
patch_actions: preserve the smallest prerequisite that changes the response branch
test cookie, bootstrap ping, round state, and account branch independently
record rejected branches as dead-end evidence
patch_classes.verification: replay returns the expected response shape under the same runtime request contract

patch_classes.label: Time Source Drift
patch_actions: capture browser time source and server-issued time separately
freeze the smallest time input in local replay
avoid replacing time logic until one accepted time sample exists
patch_classes.verification: same frozen time input produces the runtime signer output

patch_classes.label: Browser Global Shim
patch_actions: add only the missing property observed at the first thrown access
preserve the thrown stack or access path as patch provenance
do not install a broad DOM shim unless the next divergence proves it is needed
patch_classes.verification: local replay moves past the same access without changing unrelated globals

patch_classes.label: Storage or Cookie State
patch_actions: replay only the cookie or storage key used by the failing helper
preserve read/write order when the same key changes multiple times
separate state acquisition from signer computation
patch_classes.verification: local replay reads the same state value and produces the same dependent request field

patch_classes.label: Crypto Helper Output
patch_actions: compare helper input/output pairs before editing crypto internals
patch only the first differing helper input
keep unresolved signer fields parameterized
patch_classes.verification: same helper input produces the browser-observed output

patch_classes.label: Round Ladder State
patch_actions: replay prior rounds in original order before debugging the failing round
record the first round where parity breaks
avoid treating each round as stateless until disproved
patch_classes.verification: later-round replay parity returns after preserving prior-round state

patch_classes.label: Transport Profile Drift
patch_actions: compare browser and replay transport profile after request fields match
patch one header or client profile dimension at a time
do not blame TLS before request contract and state parity are established
patch_classes.verification: same request contract succeeds after one explicit transport profile patch
